name: Tsukushite Ageru no ni!! Okaeshi Disc
original_name: つくしてあげるのに！！お返しディスク
source:
A free append disc issued to meet fans demands to capture heroine Nana unavailable for capture in Tsukushite Ageru no ni!! Her story of the same length as other heroines routes of the main game. There are also short erotic after-stories for Mitsuki and Yukari.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为回应玩家希望攻略入江奈奈的呼声而免费发布的追加光盘。奈奈在《明明想为你尽心尽力！！》原作中无法攻略，本篇为她新增了与其他女主角路线长度相当的故事。此外还收录入江美月与藤见由香里的简短情色后日谈。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
